objective: Test whether the specificity-trained aligned-vector RWKV controller improves native scene-boundary generation over its matched projected-only carrier and all recurrent-state interventions on open publisher-TRAIN-derived development data.

architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: Zero recurrent state is exactly projected-only readout.
architecture.serialized_config_disclosure: The immutable signed adapter config retains rwkv_ms_hybrid_mode=recurrent_value from construction; the signed training audit and endpoint ran aligned_vector_gate after a runtime-only candidate switch.
architecture.required_runtime_restoration: After loading the immutable adapter and before priming any row, set only the non-parameter rwkv_ms_hybrid_mode attribute from recurrent_value to aligned_vector_gate on all 42 wrappers. Load and verify the serialized gain of 0.125 without changing any learned tensor.

generation.hardware: four distinct A100 GPUs, one deterministic shard per GPU
generation.projected_carrier_policy: The correct row's projected carrier is byte-identical in every condition.
generation.donor_policy: Deterministic prompt-length-matched donor with different gold boundaries.
generation.decoding: The repository's frozen deterministic native generation configuration.
generation.batch_shape_control: Generate zero, correct, donor, and layer-permuted conditions together at batch size four. Generate the explicit projected-only bypass at the same batch size using four copies of the identical zero-recurrent state, and compare the same batch position.
generation.resume_policy: Hash-bound append-only JSONL per shard and condition.

stopping_rule.pass: Establish native recurrent causal gain for this aligned-vector hybrid on the locked open development benchmark, update the README, archive the signed result, commit, and push.
stopping_rule.failure: Do not claim native recurrent gain; archive the signed failure, then lock a genuinely different state-specific hybrid before further generation testing.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or the unused 73-row strength holdout.

claim_policy.pass: May claim open-development native gain over the matched projected-only carrier with recurrent causal attribution under the locked interventions.
claim_policy.failure: May claim only the held-out teacher-forced causal preference, not native generation gain.
claim_policy.protected_replication: Forbidden without a new preregistered protocol.
